questions.question_en: If the price of sugar rises by 25%, by what percentage should a family reduce its consumption so that the expenditure remains the same?
questions.question_as: যদি চেনিৰ দাম ২৫% বৃদ্ধি হয়, তেন্তে এখন পৰিয়ালে খৰচ একে ৰাখিবলৈ ব্যৱহাৰ কিমান শতাংশ কমাব লাগিব?
questions.explanation_en: Use the formula: reduction % = (rise / (100 + rise)) x 100 = (25 / 125) x 100 = 20%.
